python3 <<'PY'
import struct,os
p='/Volumes/Portable Sandisk SSD/יומנו של יזם/Shadi/Yomano4.mp4';f=open(p,'rb');total=os.fstat(f.fileno()).st_size;at=0
while at<total:
 f.seek(at);h=f.read(8)
 if len(h)<8:break
 size,typ=struct.unpack('>I4s',h)
 if size==1:size=struct.unpack('>Q',f.read(8))[0]
 if size==0:size=total-at
 print(typ.decode('ascii','replace'),size)
 if size<8:break
 at+=size
PY
